answer: Resist sybils by minting identities through a serial verifiable-delay chain: each new ID's VDF takes the previously registered vertex as input, so a graph of N agents requires N sequential T-second proofs that parallel hardware cannot shortcut. Pricing is explicit: one compute bond plus one fee per proof, so n puppets pay n times while an honest agent pays once. Peers whisper signed VDF receipts over gossip; a fake ID lacking a chained receipt drops trust to its nadir and is pruned. Attack cost: T seconds of serial time per identity, unamortizable.
